text:
mira: quick thread to capture a decision path for the routing policy MVP. goal: agree scope so eng can start tickets tomorrow.

alex: +1. two framing options we've been debating: conservative (prefer single-region affinity, soft-evict only) vs aggressive (cross-region reroute to keep latency low at cost).

rene: my recommendation: ship conservative MVP. reasons: simpler acceptance tests, easier rollback, clearer compensation rules for customers. we can add model-aware cost routing later.

sophie: ops note: conservative reduces burst autoscale but increases tail latency for regions under strain. we need explicit SLOs per-region + a documented failover window (e.g., 30s -> degrade, 2m -> evict).

mira: proposed launch criteria for MVP:
- scope: NA + EU traffic only, Dedicated + Hosted; Private customers get baseline policy but can opt-in to advanced routing
- behavior: region affinity by default, soft-evict after sustained queue > 60s, hard-evict only for Dedicated with manual override
- telemetry: show tenant-level failover events, 99th pct latency + token-cost delta on console
- canary: 2% traffic from 3 pilot tenants for 48h, automated rollback on latency regression > 12% or errors > 2%
- finance guardrail: default routing must not increase spend > 8% for the tenant cohort

alex: add acceptance test checklist:
1) simulate region outage and assert failover within 90s
2) assert soft-evict timeline and customer notification flow
3) verify rollback command works end-to-end
4) cost regression test with synthetic load

rene: sample CLI snippet for ops canary run:
```
# enable canary: route 2% of tenant X to routing-mvp
redwoodctl routing canary --tenant tenant-x --policy routing-mvp --pct 2 --duration 48h
```

sophie: customer ask: two enterprise customers want webhook hooks for override events and a playbook doc. propose: opt-in beta for webhook + runbook PDF.

mira: agreed. decisions: conservative MVP, EU/NA-only, opt-in webhook beta. deliverables by EOW: policy spec doc, acceptance tests, 3 canary tickets assigned. owners: alex -> spec doc, rene -> tests + CLI, sophie -> runbook + webhook reqs.

mira: one more thing: escalation path if canary fails -> immediate rollback + incident channel #release-war-room and notify affected tenants.

devops-bot: created ticket RDW-3211 (routing-mvp-canary) and scheduled canary window 2026-04-03T01:00:00Z.

mira: thanks team. please add any missing risk items here before EOD. :rocket:
